display_long_description:
**#🏗️ Become a Crane**

Become a powerful robot with crane hands! Grab, lift, carry, and place heavy objects as you construct, explore the site, and experience the freedom of a construction simulation.

[media]

**#💥 Create Chaos**

Turn the construction site into your own sandbox playground. Grab, throw, smash, and move objects around as you experiment with the environment and create hilarious chaos.
[media]


**#📦 Order New Materials**

Need more materials for your next creation? Order new construction supplies and put them to work as you build, experiment, and create whatever you want around the site.
[media]

**#😈 Annoy People Around You**

The workers are trying to get their jobs done—but you don’t have to make it easy! Mess with people around the construction site and create funny, unexpected moments as you cause playful chaos.
[media]
